declared_model.structure: Rule stands alone. Semantic and evidence share the embedding model. Evidence and confidence share the NLI model. Confidence also depends on an unpinned generator.
declared_model.what_it_supports: A primary aggregation ablation, plus a labeled stress test of shared-resource failure. It is not a measured correlation.
declared_model.what_it_cannot_support: An empirical claim that failures are independent or correlated. No paired failure recordings exist.

alternatives.name: hypothetical_independent_verifiers
alternatives.assumption: Each verifier is its own dependency group.
alternatives.conclusion_limit: A loss change shows sensitivity to that assumption. It is not a measured dependence.

alternatives.name: hypothetical_shared_text_verifiers
alternatives.assumption: Semantic and evidence share one group because both use text. Rule and confidence remain separate. This follows a shared-input hypothesis, not a failure correlation.
alternatives.conclusion_limit: Useful only as a labeled stress test. It must not be described as an empirical dependency.

alternatives.name: controlled_synthetic_two_group
alternatives.assumption: The existing synthetic fixture splits verifiers into two groups.
alternatives.conclusion_limit: It checks the scoring code. It is not an alternative for the empirical heatmap.

recommendation: Use the structural shared-resource groups for the aggregation ablation. Keep every heatmap cell that needs a measured correlation marked not estimable until paired failure recordings exist. Hypothetical rows stay labeled HYPOTHETICAL_STRESS_TEST.
